title: Blueprint Frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of an i-SASE Blueprint artifact. A Blueprint is a reusable, parameterized template extracted from concrete BriefingPacks.

schema.description: Schema identifier for the Blueprint artifact type.

id.description: Unique 12-character hex identifier for the Blueprint.

slug.description: Human-readable short name (2-4 words, lowercase, hyphens). Used in directory name and display.

version.description: Semantic version. Git provides history; this is for human readability.

abstraction-level.description: Three-level hierarchy: methodology (any modernization), technology (e.g. COBOL->Java), project (concrete template).

parameters.description: Typed placeholder definitions. Each parameter maps to {{PARAM_NAME}} placeholders in the body.

name.description: Parameter name used in {{PARAM_NAME}} placeholders. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this parameter represents.

required.description: Whether this parameter must be provided during instantiation.

default.description: Default value used if the parameter is not provided. Type must match the parameter type.

enum-values.description: Valid values when type is 'enum'. Ignored for other types.

example.description: Example value from the source project (anonymized if needed).

created.description: ISO-8601 date when the Blueprint was created.

author.description: Authors or originators of the Blueprint.

provenance.description: Tracks which concrete BP tree this Blueprint was extracted from.

source-bp.description: Hash of the source BriefingPack root.

source-mission.description: Mission title of the source BriefingPack.

extracted-date.description: ISO-8601 date when the Blueprint was extracted.

extracted-by.description: Name of the person who performed the extraction.

execution-order.description: Ordered execution plan for child Blueprints. Strings = sequential, arrays = parallel groups.

description.description: Short (1-3 sentence) description of what this Blueprint produces when instantiated.

instantiation-count.description: How many times this Blueprint has been used to create concrete BPs.
